originality_red_lines: Do not reproduce the zero-talent protagonist plus time-dilation supreme artifact opening.
Do not use clan extermination as the default engine for a long revenge arc.
Do not resolve major power gaps through unearned ancient-artifact inheritance, body possession, or compliant devouring beasts.
Do not treat mortal-life enlightenment, disguised sect-ranking, arrogant-local humiliation, or ruin-betrayal loops as primary arc structures.
Do not use a terminal cosmic-origin resurrection or chessboard-of-fate reveal without independent causal costs and alternatives.
